records.title: Cloud, Infrastructure & Security Summer Internship 2027
records.clearance_check: Pass — no security clearance, citizenship or residency condition stated. Baillie Gifford cannot sponsor visas; all applicants must have the right to work in the UK.
records.work_authorisation_risk: Not assessed — owner instruction 2026-10-03: do not discuss visa status for any application.
records.key_gap: The posting requires a penultimate (second last) year student studying for a technology-related degree, with a proven interest in Cloud, Infrastructure and/or Cybersecurity. The owner completed their MSc in September 2025, so is a recent graduate rather than a current penultimate-year student. This is a hard eligibility criterion. Not evidenced and not claimed: penultimate-year student status, cloud platform experience (Azure, Terraform, Docker), CrowdStrike/Wiz/Superblocks experience. Genuinely evidenced: MSc Information Security (Merit), BCA, CompTIA Security+, ISC2 CC, IT support experience (M365, Active Directory, troubleshooting, endpoint support), Python/PowerShell/SQL, structured problem-solving (Windows error-code root-cause tool), InboxDefender project (93.7% accuracy, 25 patterns, MITRE ATT&CK), risk assessments, compliance checks, documentation, customer service, teamwork, initiative.
records.recommendation: Applied per owner instruction. Fit is moderate: the role is a cloud and infrastructure security internship at an investment management firm, and the owner's background is IT support and security. The honest gap is the penultimate-year eligibility requirement — the owner is a recent graduate, not a current student. The cover letter addresses this directly and makes the case that practical experience would allow meaningful contribution from day one. No clearance or citizenship barrier. Closing date 3 November 2026. Programme runs mid-June to late August 2027 in Edinburgh.
